title: Album release: Ringo Starr: Live At Soundstage by Ringo Starr | 2007
content:
Ringo Starr: Live At Soundstage, the ninth live album by Ringo Starr, was released on 23 October 2007.

It was recorded by the former Beatles drummer and the Roundheads on 24 June 2005 at the Genesee Theatre in Waukegan, Illinois, USA. Colin Hay and his wife Cecilia Noël joined the musicians for the final song, ‘With A Little Help From My Friends’.

A deluxe CD also came with a brief bonus DVD containing a band documentary, and versions of ‘Choose Love’, ‘It Don’t Come Easy’, ‘I’m The Greatest’, and ‘Don’t Pass Me By’.

A DVD of the full performance was also made available in 2009, titled Live or Soundstage depending on the country of release.
